name: RG20263
tagline: Architectural cast iron warmth with integrated wood storage
description: A sophisticated evolution of the high-output CJ-30, this freestanding configuration pairs a heavy-duty cast iron firebox with a modern industrial wood storage plinth. Engineered for large-scale heating, it utilizes advanced secondary and tertiary air systems to ensure maximum thermal efficiency and a cleaner burn. The expansive panoramic ceramic glass offers an unobstructed view of the fire, while the integrated wood compartment keeps logs seasoned and within easy reach, creating a striking focal point for contemporary living spaces.
features: Integrated modern log storage plinth for convenience and style
Heavy-duty Australian mineral ore cast iron construction
Panoramic viewing window with high-temp ceramic glass
Precision-controlled airwash system for clear glass maintenance
High-efficiency secondary combustion and overnight burn capability
